Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Isyn Drenin: 40-year-old woman, 179 cm (tall), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: wide triangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; broad low bridge, full lips; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: sculptural fringe. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: a carved belt buckle. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
